explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/196 with the negative answer ([Ho26] and independent Lean-formalised constructions): not every permutation of ℕ contains a monotone 4-term AP. HasMonotoneAP correctly requires increasing indices with values forming an increasing or decreasing AP. Permutations of ℕ (including 0) rather than ℕ_{>0} is harmless, by shifting.
